Japan's **Anthropic Usage Index is 1.91** for the period starting 2026-05-01.

The index is a country's share of Claude usage divided by its share of the working-age population. At 1.0, usage matches population size; the global average is set to 1.0. So Japan's Claude usage is about 91% higher than its population alone would predict. That puts Japan **32nd of 121** countries.

Other headline figures for Japan, with the global average in brackets:
- **Purpose of use:** 47% work (43%), 47% personal (40%), 6% coursework (16%).
- **How Claude is used:** 53% augmentation, where people work with Claude (51%), and 47% automation, where Claude does the task (49%).

Source and methodology: https://www.anthropic.com/economic-index
